# Vessel Data Preparation

## Loading all required packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(APCalign)
library(glmmTMB)
library(easystats)
library(ggeffects)
library(scales)
```


## Loading all required data
```{r}
vessel_areas <- read.csv("data/vessel_areas.csv", header = T)
tracheophyte_climate_preferences <- read.csv("data/tracheophyte_climate_preferences.csv", header = T)
climate_preferences <- read.csv("data/climate_preferences.csv", header = T)
```


## Calculating Dh and VLF
```{r}
# Unique image key: the same tree code can appear under two original names
vessel_areas <- vessel_areas |> 
  mutate(image_id = paste0(family_original, " ", species_name, "_", state, "_", other))

xylem_Dh <- vessel_areas |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel"|Classification == "vessel") |>
  group_by(scientificName, image_id) |> 
  summarise(sample_Dh = sum((2*radius)^5)/ sum((2*radius)^4),
            n_vessels = n()) |> 
  group_by(scientificName) |> 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(sample_Dh, na.rm=T),
            n_images = n(),
            n_vessels = sum(n_vessels),
            n_vessels_per_image = n_vessels/n_images) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = c("scientificName")) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  drop_na() 

xylem_VLF <- vessel_areas |> 
  group_by(scientificName, image_id) |> 
  mutate(sample_lumen_area = max(Area.µm.2)) |> 
  filter(Name %in% c("vessel", "part")|Classification %in% c("vessel", "part")) |> 
  group_by(scientificName, image_id) |> 
  summarise(vessel_area = sum(Area.µm.2),
            sample_lumen_frac = vessel_area/max(sample_lumen_area)) |> 
  distinct() |>
  group_by(scientificName) |> 
  summarise(mean_VLF = mean(sample_lumen_frac, na.rm=T)*100) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = c("scientificName"))|> 
  distinct() |> 
  drop_na() 


## Exporting xylem statistics (single source for all models and figures below)
xylem_stats <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(xylem_VLF |> dplyr::select(scientificName, mean_VLF), by = "scientificName") |> 
  dplyr::select(family, genus, species, scientificName, mean_Dh, mean_VLF, MAP, MAT, n_obs, n_vessels, n_images, n_vessels_per_image)

write.csv(xylem_stats, "./data/xylem_stats.csv", row.names = F)

# Filtering families and genera to plot later
selected_families <- xylem_stats |> group_by(family) |> summarise(n = n()) |> filter(n >= 10)
selected_genera <- xylem_stats |> group_by(genus, family) |> summarise(n = n()) |> filter(n >= 10)
sample_distribution <- xylem_stats |> group_by(genus, family) |> summarise(n_species = n()) |> group_by(family) |> mutate(n_genus = n())
```


## Genus sizes and trees and images per taxon (reviewer requests)
```{r}
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Genera by number of taxa: singletons inform only the across-genus term and genus intercepts
tibble(genus_size = cut(as.vector(table(xylem_stats$genus)), c(0, 1, 9, Inf), labels = c("1", "2-9", ">=10"))) |> count(genus_size)

# Each image file name holds the tree code of its slide (for example 1_1452_x.jpg -> 1452).
# Images with a missing code ("--") count as separate trees.
image_table <- vessel_areas |>
  filter(scientificName %in% xylem_stats$scientificName) |>
  distinct(scientificName, image_id, other) |>
  mutate(tree_code = str_remove(other, "_x[ .(].*$|_x$") |> str_remove("^(1|kb)_"),
         tree_code = if_else(str_detect(tree_code, "^-+$|^x[.]jpg$"), image_id, tree_code))

sample_structure <- image_table |>
  group_by(scientificName) |>
  summarise(trees = n_distinct(tree_code), images = n())
write.csv(sample_structure, "tables/sample_structure_per_taxon.csv", row.names = F)

sample_structure |>
  summarise(taxa = n(), total_trees = sum(trees), total_images = sum(images),
            mean_trees_per_taxon = mean(trees), median_trees_per_taxon = median(trees),
            mean_images_per_taxon = mean(images), images_per_tree = sum(images) / sum(trees))
sample_structure |> count(trees, name = "taxa")
```

# Statistical modelling
## Dh mixed model
```{r}
# Data preparation
xylem_Dh_genus <- xylem_stats |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(
    log_Dh = log(mean_Dh),
    log_MAP = log(MAP),
    genus_mean_MAP = mean(log(MAP)),
    genus_mean_Dh = mean(log(mean_Dh))
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    diff_from_genus_MAP = log_MAP - genus_mean_MAP,
  )

# Mixed model with genus-centering
xylem_Dh_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(log_Dh ~ genus_mean_MAP + 
                                  diff_from_genus_MAP +
                                  (1 | family) + 
                                  (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                                data = xylem_Dh_genus,
                                family = gaussian())

# Results - Mixed model
parameters(xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
summary(xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
r2(xylem_Dh_mixed_model)

# Simple model
xylem_Dh_regular_model <- glmmTMB(log_Dh ~ log_MAP, data = xylem_Dh_genus,
                                family = gaussian())

# Results - simple model
parameters(xylem_Dh_regular_model)
summary(xylem_Dh_regular_model)
r2(xylem_Dh_regular_model)

# Comparison
compare_performance(xylem_Dh_regular_model, xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
anova(xylem_Dh_regular_model, xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
``` 

## VLF mixed model
```{r}
# Data preparation
xylem_VLF_genus <- xylem_stats |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(
    log_VLF = log(mean_VLF),
    log_MAP = log(MAP),
    genus_mean_MAP = mean(log(MAP)),
    genus_mean_VLF = mean(log(mean_VLF))
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    diff_from_genus_MAP = log_MAP - genus_mean_MAP,
  )

xylem_VLF_genus$genus <- as.factor(xylem_VLF_genus$genus)
xylem_VLF_genus$family <- as.factor(xylem_VLF_genus$family)

# Mixed model with genus-centering
xylem_VLF_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(log_VLF ~ genus_mean_MAP + 
                                  diff_from_genus_MAP +
                                  (1 | family) + 
                                  (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                                data = xylem_VLF_genus,
                                family = gaussian())

# Mixed model testing
parameters(xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
summary(xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
r2(xylem_VLF_mixed_model)

# Simple model
xylem_VLF_regular_model <- glmmTMB(log_VLF ~ log_MAP,
                                data = xylem_VLF_genus,
                                family = gaussian())

# Simple model testing
parameters(xylem_VLF_regular_model)
summary(xylem_VLF_regular_model)
r2(xylem_VLF_regular_model)

# Comparison
compare_performance(xylem_VLF_regular_model, xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
anova(xylem_VLF_regular_model, xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
```


## Table 2 Variance partitioning
```{r}
# Random-slope variance is weighted by the mean squared predictor (Johnson 2014);
# the covariance term drops out because diff_from_genus_MAP has mean 0.
variance_table <- function(model, data) {
  vc <- VarCorr(model)$cond
  sd_genus <- attr(vc$genus, "stddev")
  sd_family <- attr(vc$family, "stddev")
  variance <- c(
    var(predict(model, re.form = NA)),
    sd_genus[2]^2 * mean(data$diff_from_genus_MAP^2),
    sd_genus[1]^2,
    sd_family^2,
    sigma(model)^2
  )
  tibble(
    source = c("Fixed (MAP)", "Genus (slope)", "Genus (intercept)", "Family (intercept)", "Residual"),
    SD = c(NA, sd_genus[2], sd_genus[1], sd_family, sigma(model)),
    variance = variance,
    percent = 100 * variance / sum(variance)
  )
}

variance_table(xylem_Dh_mixed_model, xylem_Dh_genus)
variance_table(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, xylem_VLF_genus)
```


## Slope interpretation (log-log elasticities)
```{r}
# Natural logs: a slope b means the trait changes by (2^b - 1) x 100 % when MAP doubles
elasticity_table <- function(model, label) {
  s <- summary(model)$coefficients$cond
  s <- s[rownames(s) != "(Intercept)", , drop = FALSE]
  tibble(model = label, term = rownames(s), slope = s[, 1],
         conf.low = s[, 1] - 1.96 * s[, 2], conf.high = s[, 1] + 1.96 * s[, 2]) |>
    mutate(across(c(slope, conf.low, conf.high),
                  list(pct_doubling = \(b) 100 * (2^b - 1), pct_plus10 = \(b) 100 * (1.1^b - 1))))
}

slope_interpretation <- bind_rows(
  elasticity_table(xylem_Dh_mixed_model, "Dh mixed"),
  elasticity_table(xylem_Dh_regular_model, "Dh pooled"),
  elasticity_table(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, "VLF mixed"),
  elasticity_table(xylem_VLF_regular_model, "VLF pooled")
)
write.csv(slope_interpretation, "tables/slope_interpretation.csv", row.names = F)
slope_interpretation |> select(model, term, slope, conf.low, conf.high, slope_pct_doubling, slope_pct_plus10)
```


## Within-genus slopes for genera with >= 10 taxa
```{r}
# Fitted within-genus slope of each genus (fixed slope + genus BLUP) with an approximate 95% CI.
# SE = sqrt(var(fixed slope) + conditional var(BLUP)); their covariance is ignored, as in arm::se.coef.
genus_slopes <- function(model, genera) {
  b <- fixef(model)$cond["diff_from_genus_MAP"]
  v <- vcov(model)$cond["diff_from_genus_MAP", "diff_from_genus_MAP"]
  as.data.frame(ranef(model, condVar = TRUE)) |>
    filter(grpvar == "genus", term == "diff_from_genus_MAP", grp %in% genera) |>
    transmute(genus = as.character(grp), slope = b + condval, se = sqrt(v + condsd^2),
              conf.low = slope - 1.96 * se, conf.high = slope + 1.96 * se)
}

genus_slope_table <- bind_rows(
  genus_slopes(xylem_Dh_mixed_model, selected_genera$genus) |> mutate(trait = "Dh"),
  genus_slopes(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, selected_genera$genus) |> mutate(trait = "VLF")
) |> left_join(selected_genera |> ungroup() |> select(genus, n), by = "genus")
write.csv(genus_slope_table, "tables/genus_slopes.csv", row.names = F)
genus_slope_table
```


## Within-genus prediction helper
```{r}
# Predicts each genus line at its own genus mean MAP and family, over its own MAP range
predict_within_genus <- function(model, data) {
  newdata <- data |>
    group_by(genus, family, genus_mean_MAP) |>
    filter(n() >= 2) |>
    reframe(x = seq(min(diff_from_genus_MAP), max(diff_from_genus_MAP), length.out = 50)) |>
    mutate(diff_from_genus_MAP = x)
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, re.form = NULL, se.fit = TRUE)
  newdata |>
    mutate(predicted = pred$fit,
           conf.low = pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit,
           conf.high = pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit,
           x_scaled = genus_mean_MAP + x)
}
```

```{r}
# ── 1. Create family-level colour palette ────────────────────────────────────
selected_families <- selected_families |> mutate(color = scales::hue_pal()(n_distinct(family))[as.integer(factor(family))])
```

## Fig. 4a Dh family plot, mainly by Claude Sonnet 4.6
```{r}
# ── 1. Across-genus marginal effect ──────────────────────────────────────────
Dh_across_pred <- ggpredict(xylem_Dh_mixed_model, terms = "genus_mean_MAP [all]")

# ── 2. Family-level predictions ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Family only has a random intercept (1 | family), so we predict
# over genus_mean_MAP for each family
Dh_family_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_Dh_mixed_model,
  terms = c("genus_mean_MAP [all]", "family [all]"),
  type = "random"
)

# Copy with genus column for the genus panels (keeps one row per family for the family panels)
Dh_family_pred_genus <- as_tibble(Dh_family_pred) |> inner_join(selected_genera, by = c("group" = "family"))

# ── 3. Compute axis breaks from data range ────────────────────────────────────
Dh_y_range <- exp(range(xylem_Dh_genus$log_Dh, na.rm = TRUE))
Dh_x_range <- exp(range(xylem_Dh_genus$genus_mean_MAP + xylem_Dh_genus$diff_from_genus_MAP, na.rm = TRUE))

Dh_y_breaks <- log(log_breaks(n = 6)(Dh_y_range))
Dh_x_breaks <- log(log_breaks(n = 4)(Dh_x_range))

# Compute n per family, optionally restrict to only the families you're plotting
family_n <- xylem_Dh_genus |>
  dplyr::group_by(family) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(family %in% selected_families$family) # Remove this line if you want n for ALL families


# ── 4. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
  geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> dplyr::select(-family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Across-family line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Selected family points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> filter(family %in% selected_families$family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh,
    colour = family), size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_ribbon(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = family),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = family),
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
# sample size label
  geom_text(
    data = family_n,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    hjust = -0.25, vjust = 1.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 2.5,
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = expression(italic(D)[h] ~ "(μm, log scale)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation\n(mm, log scale)"
  ) +
  labs(
    colour = "Family", fill = "Family"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
  ) -> Dh_family_facet

Dh_family_facet
```

```{r}
    colour = family), size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_ribbon(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = family),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = family),
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
# sample size label
  geom_text(
    data = family_n,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    hjust = -0.25, vjust = 1.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 2.5,
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = "VLF (%, log scale)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation\n(mm, log scale)"
  ) +
  labs(
    colour = "Family", fill = "Family"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
  ) -> VLF_family_facet

VLF_family_facet
```

## Fig. 5b VLF genus plot, mainly by Claude Sonnet 4.6
```{r}
# ── 1. Across-genus marginal effect ──────────────────────────────────────────
VLF_across_pred <- ggpredict(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, terms = "genus_mean_MAP [all]")

# ── Average within-genus response (population-level, no random effects) ───────
VLF_avg_within_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_VLF_mixed_model,
  terms = "diff_from_genus_MAP [all]"
  # type = "fixed" is default — random effects set to 0
)

# Recentre to global mean MAP so it sits on the same x-axis
global_mean_MAP <- mean(xylem_VLF_genus$genus_mean_MAP, na.rm = TRUE)

VLF_avg_within_scaled <- as_tibble(VLF_avg_within_pred) %>%
  mutate(x_scaled = x + global_mean_MAP)

# ── 2. Within-genus predictions per genus, on the across-genus x-axis ─────────
VLF_within_pred_scaled <- predict_within_genus(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, xylem_VLF_genus)


# Full dataset with family info, minus genus column for background
family_background <- xylem_VLF_genus %>%
  select(-genus) %>%                    # removes genus so points appear in all panels
  left_join(
    xylem_VLF_genus %>% distinct(genus, family),
    by = "family"                       # rejoin by family so points appear in
  ) |>                                  # all genera panels within the same family
  filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus)

# ── 5. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
    geom_point(
    data = xylem_VLF_genus |> dplyr::select(-genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF),
    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Across-genus line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Selected genus points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_VLF_genus |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF), 
    col = "grey40", size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1
  ) +
  # Within-genus lines — coloured, scaled to global x-axis
  geom_ribbon(
    data = VLF_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    fill = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = VLF_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted),
    col = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_line(
    data = VLF_family_pred_genus |> rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, col = genus),
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
# sample size label
  geom_text(
    data = genus_n,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    hjust = -0.25, vjust = 1.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 2.5,
  ) +
  # Facet by genus
  facet_wrap(~ genus, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = "VLF (%, log scale)"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation\n(mm, log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
  ) -> VLF_genus_facet

VLF_genus_facet
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==========================================
# 📝 MODIFIABLE LEGEND TEXT & PROPERTIES
# ==========================================
line_labels <- c(
  "Within-genus" = "Within-genus",
  "Simple regression" = "Simple regression",
  "Across-genus" = "Across-genus",
  "Average within-genus" = "Avg. within-genus"
)
line_colors <- c(
  "Within-genus" = "grey50",
  "Simple regression" = "red",
  "Across-genus" = "black",
  "Average within-genus" = "blue"
)
line_types <- c(
  "Within-genus" = "solid",
  "Simple regression" = "dashed",
  "Across-genus" = "solid",
  "Average within-genus" = "solid"
)

# --- Dh_genus plot ---
Dh_genus <- ggplot() +
  # Taxa from genera with one taxon, filled, under the open grey points
  geom_point(data = xylem_Dh_genus |> add_count(genus) |> filter(n == 1),
             aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh, fill = "Genus with one taxon"),
             colour = "grey20", size = 1.3, shape = 21) +
  geom_point(data = xylem_Dh_genus, aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
             colour = "grey40", size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Genus with one taxon" = "orange"), guide = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  geom_line(data = Dh_within_pred_scaled, aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, group = genus, color = "Within-genus"),
            linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

            linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

            linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = Dh_avg_within_scaled, aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, color = "Average within-genus"),

    guide = guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = Dh_y_breaks, labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1), name = expression(italic(D)[h] ~ "(μm, log scale)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = Dh_x_breaks, labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0), name = "Mean Annual Precipitation\n(mm, log scale)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")
  )

# --- VLF_genus plot (identical scale setup) ---
VLF_genus <- ggplot() +
  # Taxa from genera with one taxon, filled, under the open grey points
  geom_point(data = xylem_VLF_genus |> add_count(genus) |> filter(n == 1),
             aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF, fill = "Genus with one taxon"),
             colour = "grey20", size = 1.3, shape = 21) +
  geom_point(data = xylem_VLF_genus, aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF),
             colour = "grey40", size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1) +

            linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  geom_line(data = as_tibble(VLF_across_pred), aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = "Across-genus"),

  geom_line(data = VLF_avg_within_scaled, aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, color = "Average within-genus"),

  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = VLF_y_breaks, labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1), name = "VLF (%, log scale)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = VLF_x_breaks, labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0), name = "Mean Annual Precipitation\n(mm, log scale)") +
```

# Other
## Fig. S1 Zanne et al. (2010) comparison
```{r}
zanne_data <- read.csv("data/zanne_data.csv", header = T)

# Calculating same variables on our data (study taxa only, one value per image)
taxon_vessel_metrics <- vessel_areas |>
  filter(scientificName %in% xylem_stats$scientificName) |>
  group_by(scientificName, image_id) |> 
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000, 
         total_area = max(area_mm)) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel"|Classification == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(scientificName, image_id, total_area) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_area = mean(area_mm, na.rm=T), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(n_per_area = n/total_area) |> 
  group_by(scientificName) |> 
  summarise(N = mean(n_per_area, na.rm = T),         # Vessel density
            A = mean(mean_area, na.rm = T)) |>       # Mean area 
  left_join(xylem_stats |> dplyr::select(scientificName, family, species), by = "scientificName")

comparison_data <- taxon_vessel_metrics |>
  filter(family %in% zanne_data$Family,              # Families present in both datasets
         family %in% selected_families$family)       # with >= 10 taxa, as in Figs 5-6

ggplot() +
  geom_hex(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), bins = 10, col = "light grey", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "forestgreen") +
  geom_point(data = comparison_data, aes(x = N, y = A), size = 0.05) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Vessel density"~ (mm^-2*", log scale")) +
  ylab("Mean vessel area"~ (mm^2*", log scale")) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  labs(fill = "Count")


ggsave("figures/figS2.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 14, units = "cm",dpi = 330)
```

## Fig. S1b Direct comparison with Zanne et al. (2010) for shared species
```{r}
# Species in both datasets; infraspecific taxa of one species are averaged
matched_zanne <- taxon_vessel_metrics |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(A_this_study = mean(A), N_this_study = mean(N)) |>
  inner_join(zanne_data |> group_by(Binomial) |> summarise(A_zanne = mean(A), N_zanne = mean(N)),
             by = c("species" = "Binomial"))
write.csv(matched_zanne, "tables/zanne_matched_species.csv", row.names = F)

matched_summary <- tibble(
  variable = c("Mean vessel area (A)", "Vessel density (N)"),
  n = nrow(matched_zanne),
  r_log10 = c(cor(log10(matched_zanne$A_this_study), log10(matched_zanne$A_zanne)),
              cor(log10(matched_zanne$N_this_study), log10(matched_zanne$N_zanne))),
  median_ratio = c(median(matched_zanne$A_this_study / matched_zanne$A_zanne),
                   median(matched_zanne$N_this_study / matched_zanne$N_zanne))
)
matched_summary

matched_long <- bind_rows(
  matched_zanne |> transmute(species, variable = "Mean vessel area (A)", zanne = A_zanne, this_study = A_this_study),
  matched_zanne |> transmute(species, variable = "Vessel density (N)", zanne = N_zanne, this_study = N_this_study)
)
matched_labels <- matched_summary |> mutate(label = sprintf("n = %d, r = %.2f", n, r_log10))

ggplot(matched_long, aes(x = zanne, y = this_study)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 1, shape = 1) +
  geom_text(data = matched_labels, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Zanne et al. (2010), log scale", y = "This study, log scale") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"))

ggsave("figures/zanne_matched_species.png", scale = 1, width = 15.92, height = 8, units = "cm", dpi = 330)
```
